title: E-commerce System
description: Developed a backend-based e-commerce system using Spring Boot, MyBatis Plus and MySQL. The system includes product, order and user management features, with REST APIs for communication between the frontend and backend.

title: Online Mall
description: Developed a web-based online mall using Vue.js and Bootstrap. The project included product browsing, shopping cart and order management features.

title: Face Recognition Attendance System
description: Worked as part of a six-member team to develop a face recognition attendance system. The project focused on using software and computer vision technologies to support attendance management.

title: 3D Web Visualisation
description: Developed 3D web visualisation features during an internship at the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences. Worked with Vue.js and Three.js to load 3D models and implement lighting, shadows, camera movement and path-based animation.
